evals.name: Triggers on explicit review request
evals.description: The skill should activate when the user explicitly asks for a review.
evals.prompt: Please review this code for me: function add(a, b) { return a + b; }

evals.name: Scores all 10 dimensions on review
evals.description: When triggered, the skill must produce scores for all 10 review dimensions.
evals.prompt: Can you do a thorough review of the following pull request? The PR refactors the authentication middleware to use JWT tokens.

evals.name: Does not trigger on unrelated tasks
evals.description: The skill should NOT activate for tasks unrelated to code review.
evals.prompt: What's the weather like in Tokyo today?
